answer.text: The Technical Specifications list the spark plug only by make: Champion.
The same specification lists the spark plug gap as 0.8 mm to 0.9 mm.

disclaimers.text: The manual evidence available here gives only the brand (Champion) and does not state an exact spark-plug part number, so I cannot tell you which part number to order.
To get the correct part number, check with a Royal Enfield authorised service centre or parts counter rather than guessing.
